preconditions: Before each merge and final acceptance
steps: Record main/PR head, deployed admin.system.info commit and bootedAt, deploy workflow, app APK/OTA update and test date. Refresh after any change.
expected_result: Backend and installed app are the intended candidate; unknown historical attempt revisions remain unknown.
required_evidence: Release record with exact SHAs and app update ID.

steps: Integrate latest main, retarget temporary-base PRs to main after dependencies land, inspect task-only diff, run affected tests/build/lint/typecheck.
expected_result: No reverted dependency fixes or untested conflict resolutions; no reliance on a CLEAN merge badge or empty CI rollup.
required_evidence: Diff review and exact executed commands/results at head SHA.

steps: Review nullable receipt migration, database backup, stable existing encryption key, old workers and in-flight publishing; follow Task 2 rollout/drain procedure. Check migration and startup after deploy.
expected_result: No mixed old uploader writes bypassing receipt; schema/client compatible; receipts preserved through restart/rollback planning.
required_evidence: Backup/migration/worker/version record; no secret values.

steps: Run bounded Admin diagnostics for an explicitly selected planner attempt and a completed attempt. Check auth denial, audit behavior, missing fields and safe export; check Task 2 summary integration availability explicitly.
expected_result: Correct run/attempt data; null remains unknown; no eligibility consumed, counter changed, token/session URI or prompt leaked.
required_evidence: Sanitized diagnostic export and before/after counter evidence.

steps: Save style, banned phrases, voice, mood, fact policy, packaging and offered formats. Start a sandbox run; change active profile and verify the existing run keeps its snapshot while a new run uses the new version.
expected_result: Profile persistence, version history, resolver precedence and run snapshot agree.
required_evidence: Profile IDs, resolvedOptions and screenshots.

steps: Switch Shorts/Video, select offered formats, use Freeform, try a channel with no offered formats and a read-only role.
expected_result: Only applicable offered formats show; format locks length; Freeform sends no formatKey; no-format channel works; unauthorized edits denied.
required_evidence: Screenshots and captured non-secret request fields.

steps: Exercise 2/5/10/15-minute estimates and invalid 1/16/fractional lengths; failed estimate; too-low spend limit; disconnected channel.
expected_result: Server validations displayed; failed long estimate disables Create; Shorts retain existing behavior; no hidden run starts.
required_evidence: Validation screenshots and API regression results.

steps: Test weekly allocation and per-run cap before calls, failed-call usage booking, insufficient budget on create/retry, and explicitly raising only maxCostUsd.
expected_result: Distinct actionable limits; no calls after refusal; existing weekly budget cannot be bypassed by raising per-run cap.
required_evidence: Usage rows/call counts and sandbox API results.

preconditions: L1: final integrated candidate, approved brief/channel/spend, manual gates
steps: Create one 2-minute long video from the phone using supplied facts and an offered long format or Freeform. Follow through both gates and reuse the output for media, repair and publishing tests.
expected_result: A complete real pipeline is observed; stage state, target, estimate, actual spend and approval decisions agree.
required_evidence: Run ID, candidate SHA, stage timeline, final artifacts and phone recording.

preconditions: L1 at Gate 1; invalid branch uses sandbox
steps: Inspect chapters/concerns/sources; try an edit with too few chapters, then valid chapter edit preserving approved facts.
expected_result: Invalid edit rejected before production; valid approved chapter text is what narration/planning consume; correct approver recorded.
required_evidence: Gate output snapshot and chapter/script comparison.

preconditions: Script review fixtures, not repeated paid generation
steps: Exercise score below 7 during allowed retries, retry-cap and budget-stop escalation, passing score, and gate disabled.
expected_result: Below-threshold drafts retry when allowed; exhausted/budget-limited drafts may reach human Gate 1 with explicit reason; low scores never auto-approve merely because gate is disabled.
required_evidence: Score/attempt/budget/decision assertions and escalation UI.

steps: Test approve/reject/revise, decision resubmission/double tap and gate reopen after failed decision save.
expected_result: One accepted decision; reject/revise follows configured path; correct actor/history; no stuck gate or stale approval.
required_evidence: Decision log and UI state evidence.

steps: Compare resolvedOptions/profile snapshot with heard voice, selected music/source, target and format; inspect editor/source packaging later.
expected_result: Displayed run/profile/format/default origins are truthful; Auto is not relabelled as a known choice before the planner chooses.
required_evidence: Resolved input versus artifact notes.

preconditions: L1 generating and sandbox cached/substituted paths
steps: Observe done/total image count across generated/cache/moderation results and retry; leave and return to screen.
expected_result: Counter is bounded and attempt-scoped, clears outside generation, and does not imply all images were newly generated or valid; no invented percentage/ETA.
required_evidence: Polling samples and screenshots.

preconditions: Historical duplicate run plus sandbox reproduction
steps: Compare run status, latest attempt and historical attempts after retry/cancel; inspect run 9ab4fbe5 structure without retrying it.
expected_result: One truthful current state; old running rows cannot imply live work on a terminal run; stale rows are distinguished from active workers and any defect stays open.
required_evidence: Stage-row chronology, screen capture and worker/call evidence if reproduced.

steps: Follow Queue, Inbox and Run through refresh/relaunch, search, both gate decisions, publishing and ended runs.
expected_result: Per-run Inbox grouping, current status and count correct; no brief-stage reset at publishing; history available; search works without creating duplicate work.
required_evidence: One journey screen recording.

steps: Cancel during provider wait/generation, cancel twice, refresh/relaunch and simulate restart; verify terminal state and subsequent call counts.
expected_result: Cancelling eventually resolves truthfully; no later paid calls except documented already-in-flight request; no revived run; stage records/UI reconciled.
required_evidence: Cancel response, timeline, calls and terminal UI.

preconditions: Retry/revise cap fixtures and eligible legacy checkpoint
steps: Exercise ordinary/manual/automatic caps, one-use legacy planner exception, cancel/archive and insufficient-budget refusals.
expected_result: Existing counters/allowance enforced once; no UI-enabled action that backend rejects without explanation; no unlimited retry.
required_evidence: Counter and provider-call assertions.

preconditions: Correct APK native push support and OTA; manual gates
steps: Verify one actionable gate notification, foreground/background receipt, reopen after restart and resolved-card history.
expected_result: Current gate opens; duplicate reminder does not create duplicate card/decision; permission/token issue explained; OTA alone not treated as native rebuild.
required_evidence: Device/OTA IDs and notification screenshots; no repeated paid run.

preconditions: Completed, failed, rejected, cancelled and empty channels
steps: Check dashboard counts, ended runs, run details and per-attempt history across these states.
expected_result: Counts and success denominator match underlying runs; cancellation/rejection labels not hidden or miscounted; per-run spend is real.
required_evidence: Screenshots and counted run IDs; per-attempt spend UI remains separate scope if absent.

steps: Feed quotes, truncated output, normal-stop wrong counts, malformed JSON and failed correction/split fixtures.
expected_result: Existing fixed slots/count validation and bounded correction/split recovery succeed or stop explicitly; no duplicate planner rewrite or silent partial plan.
required_evidence: Focused planner tests with stop/count/call metadata.

steps: Validate original chapter property order, matching checkpoint reuse, changed-input rejection, accepted scene carry-forward and single-use eligibility.
expected_result: Compatible paid prompts retained; mismatches rejected; diagnostics does not consume allowance; no recovered count inferred from missing metadata.
required_evidence: Hash/scene/counter and call-count assertions.

steps: Stop after chapter plan, TTS/ASR chunk, still and completed chapter boundaries; resume with budget/cancel controls.
expected_result: Completed valid work reused; missing work resumes; no second full plan/TTS/image batch; spending counted across attempts.
required_evidence: Before/after hashes, calls, usage and process-exit record.

steps: Race Retry/resume around video/script generation failure and cancellation; distinguish stale rows from concurrent active providers.
expected_result: At most one effective driver/paid generation action for the same intended work, or an identified unfixed gap blocks closure; publishing lease alone is insufficient proof.
required_evidence: DB timeline plus mock provider/worker counts.

steps: Compare writer/reviewer common evidence block, effective policy and canonical hash for long/Shorts; tamper hash or conflicting legacy fields.
expected_result: Same factual input reaches both; long is brief-only; invalid/conflicting values rejected before calls; key stability preserves array/text order.
required_evidence: Request-parity/hash tests.

steps: Pass source URLs without fetched text and instructions embedded in brief/source data.
expected_result: URLs remain unfetched/citation-only; source data is delimited; no approved excerpt producer or extra retrieval/model call introduced.
required_evidence: Prompt/call assertions; no universal injection-resistance claim.

preconditions: Stored generation attempt and modified channel defaults
steps: Retry/restart/review the corresponding generation after profile/source/policy changes.
expected_result: Review reuses that generation's immutable stored packet and matching references, never newer channel facts; no snapshot silently rebuilt.
required_evidence: Stored input/reference equality and restart test.

preconditions: Packet-absent old rows and incomplete historical input fixtures
steps: Read/retry supported legacy inputs; inspect missing provenance and output/result schema compatibility.
expected_result: Old output remains readable; uncertain historical evidence explicit; score thresholds and gate behavior unchanged.
required_evidence: Legacy and reviewer schema tests.

preconditions: Complete supplied factual brief and labelled miss-log cases
steps: Check named facts/numbers/hedges and a planted unsupported claim against supplied permitted text; record writer/reviewer misses separately.
expected_result: Human approves only supported final facts; evidence parity is not called verified fact-checking or SR-1–SR-9 completion; incomplete original cases not scored as full replays.
required_evidence: Brief/script claim checklist, concerns and fixture coverage limits.

preconditions: Final long video on final candidate
steps: Probe and watch full video: 1920x1080, 30fps, H.264/yuv420p, audio, measured duration/narration, loudness/peak, transitions and ending; inspect external SRT.
expected_result: Actual export meets existing hard gates; target -14 LUFS +/-1, peak <=-1 dBTP and warning bands reported honestly; long subtitles not expected burned in.
required_evidence: ffprobe/existing QC JSON plus watch/listen notes.

preconditions: Repeated anchor/ASR/chapter fixtures plus L1 map
steps: Trace full chapter-local narration spans through exact/aligned/fallback mapping; inspect both sides of boundary cuts.
expected_result: Correct scene/chapter/asset at actual frame interval; fallback explicit, impossible order fails; synthetic render is labelled synthetic.
required_evidence: Mapping JSON and timestamped frame/clip evidence.

steps: Check stable scene IDs, actual image hashes/source IDs, meaning metadata/legacy compatibility and render cache signature after byte replacement.
expected_result: Substitution recorded; actual file identity determines affected render invalidation; metadata does not claim semantic/factual correctness.
required_evidence: Mapping and before/after hashes.

preconditions: Known dbf432ff pacing failure and valid pacing fixtures
steps: Verify old 19.4s hold remains diagnosed; test final integrated distribution with actual shot durations, corrective notes and bounded retries.
expected_result: Normal acceptance video passes configured pacing gate; failures remain explicit without lowering limit to force a pass. Mapping alone is not proof of good pacing.
required_evidence: Shot-duration measurements, rendered spans and review outcome.

preconditions: S1: 30-45s AI-stills Short at final candidate
steps: Create once and inspect full portrait file, caption alignment/safe area, stock/still separation, voice/music balance, last syllable/end tail and repeated playback.
expected_result: 1080x1920/30fps, <=60s; captions follow script where enabled, no clipped text, unintended freeze or audio cutoff; actual selected style/voice applies.
required_evidence: Short run ID, QC, full playback notes and phone capture.

steps: Reproduce an off-topic/black middle shot, repeated rejected clip and retry/AI-fallback limits; inspect corrected rendered stock sample.
expected_result: Bad stock is not silently accepted or repeatedly reused without bound; legitimate motion preserved; no long-form stock path accidentally enabled.
required_evidence: Review/call/excluded-source evidence and rendered fixture.

preconditions: Gate 2 preview, full video and SRT available
steps: Play preview over normal connection, seek chapter boundaries, background/return, download SRT; renew expired signed links and test missing-preview retry in sandbox.
expected_result: Correct current video plays with audio; SRT text/timing correct; preview-only failure retries cheap review stage, not full paid generation; access protected.
required_evidence: Phone video, artifact hashes, subtitle parse and retry call counts.

mode: Scale fixture + one qualified long run
preconditions: After core pass; approved current-cost ceiling
steps: Run full-size mocked 200-slot planning/render-boundary tests; qualify a representative 10-minute real run once if long-duration capability is being signed off. Reuse suitable final-candidate evidence where available.
expected_result: No output-cap/count regression, memory/stall or accumulating alignment drift; cost and duration measured. A 2-minute pass does not certify 10/15 minutes.
required_evidence: Scale test logs; real long-run evidence or explicitly unverified duration scope.

preconditions: Implemented/frozen Task 5 contract; unpublished L1 or licensed local baseline
steps: Submit one located continuity/composition defect for a stable scene ID using matching script/evidence/voice/timing/render fingerprints.
expected_result: Only eligible visual repair accepted; no new slots, full plan or factual/script/audio edit; scene IDs/purpose/spans preserved.
required_evidence: Repair input/receipt and eligibility assertions.

steps: Replace exactly one chosen image and rebuild affected chapter/final/preview; compare every unaffected asset and narration/transcript/SRT/audio/chapter hash.
expected_result: Only selected assets and dependent outputs change; unaffected chapters and audio/timing retained; no unnecessary paid calls.
required_evidence: Before/after dependency manifest, cache hits/calls and frame totals.

steps: Try changed evidence/script/voice/timing, wrong/duplicate scene IDs, truncated images, same-path new bytes and missing terminal caches.
expected_result: Unsafe reuse rejected with reason; corrupt cache is a miss; changed bytes invalidate affected render; no invented safe reuse or silent factual repair.
required_evidence: Negative-case results and artifact hashes.

steps: Stop after intent save, provider/asset write, replacement checkpoint and chapter render; resume.
expected_result: Intent durable before spend, valid accepted replacements reused, only missing work resumed; unavoidable response-before-checkpoint window documented honestly.
required_evidence: Receipt versions, crash-point/call/cost table.

steps: Return refusal and neighboring-image substitution during repair.
expected_result: Source/target/substitution explicit; successful file render does not falsely clear the visual defect.
required_evidence: Unresolved defect/receipt and mapped rendered image.

steps: Inspect updated final/preview/QC references and review/Gate 2 transition; try old approval and old publishing artifact identity.
expected_result: Changed video re-enters existing review/Gate 2; stale approval/upload cannot publish replacement; no public upload as part of repair.
required_evidence: New artifact hashes, review/gate stages and blocked stale publish.

preconditions: Approved local/licensed baseline; freeze criteria before viewing
steps: Render A/B with identical narration/evidence/timing and one scene change; watch surrounding cuts and listen; judge identity/era, narration fit, artifacts and distraction, hiding labels if practical.
expected_result: Technical/mechanical tests pass; record better/worse/inconclusive separately. Creative adoption only if judged better without regression; no retention-uplift claim.
required_evidence: Playable A/B, blinded order if used, editorial notes, cost/reuse and hashes.

steps: Exercise budget before paid call, exhausted manual/auto cap, cancellation/archive and absent reusable baseline.
expected_result: Existing caps and cancellation honored; no fresh unlimited allowance, automatic budget increase or unsafe fallback; full regeneration uses existing approval path.
required_evidence: Refusal/call-count/state assertions.

steps: Select intended private visibility, approve once, double tap, change approved file/metadata/Gate 2 identity in negative fixtures.
expected_result: Receipt binds exact approved file/metadata/channel/Gate 2; one effective owner; changed identity rejected rather than uploaded under stale approval.
required_evidence: Approval identity, file hash and receipt assertions.

steps: Inspect title/description/tags, valid chapter list, no #shorts on long, editor/source/music credits, kids flag, category/language and privacy.
expected_result: Fields match resolved approved inputs; invalid chapters warn rather than fabricate; no leftover placeholders; citation credit not represented as fetched verification.
required_evidence: Metadata body assertion and YouTube Studio comparison.

preconditions: Publishing fault tests pass; explicit approved channel/visibility, current quota and spend
steps: Publish the accepted final L1 artifact once; inspect durable first video ID and final stage completion.
expected_result: Receipt/ID persists before optional effects; one video ID for run; app shows actual published video; final privacy confirmed private.
required_evidence: Run/video ID, safe receipt summary and provider privacy readback.

preconditions: Named DB and fake resumable provider
steps: Race two retry callers/processes, expire owner lease and deliver late owner response.
expected_result: One fenced DB owner; same saved session only; consistent first ID prevents new insertion; stale writes blocked/observations reconciled.
required_evidence: Sessions/byte submissions/IDs/owner-epoch counts.

steps: Fail session persistence, interrupt partial bytes, lose final response, kill worker, fail/expire status query and resume.
expected_result: No bytes before saved session; resume provider-confirmed offset/session; ambiguous possible upload blocks new insertion; no duplicate upload claim unsupported by evidence.
required_evidence: Crash matrix and durable receipt versus fake-provider counts.

preconditions: Legacy stage outputs with zero/one/conflicting IDs
steps: Import IDs across completed/failed/old attempts; test unsupported receipt version, uncertain old outcome and conflicting IDs.
expected_result: Existing consistent ID reused; conflicts/uncertain legacy evidence fail closed; old failed status cannot justify new upload.
required_evidence: Legacy cases and zero-new-insertion assertions.

steps: Fail R2 copy, thumbnail/caption request or response/write; retry/restart; inspect existing subtitle status/message/download.
expected_result: No second video upload; retry only safe follow-up work; uncertain non-idempotent caption/thumbnail outcome is not blindly repeated; .srt remains downloadable.
required_evidence: Session/ID/optional-effect counts and app failure display.

preconditions: Current approved account; no new credential creation
steps: Check required consent/eligibility; simulate expired auth, quota and thumbnail permission denial; distinguish missing scopes from failed media.
expected_result: Actionable reconnect/quota/feature message; no unbounded retries or silent lost upload; no assumed consent/eligibility based on old docs.
required_evidence: Auth-health/feature checks and mocked error results.

steps: Watch YouTube playback, inspect chapters/caption track/language/thumbnail and app confirmation link; compare final repaired artifact.
expected_result: Right final video published privately once; optional subtitle/thumbnail failures disclosed without false full success or reupload.
required_evidence: YouTube Studio/player screenshots and matching video ID.

preconditions: Completed long/Short and empty channel data
steps: Switch Compare Shorts/Videos/Freeform and inspect newest snapshot selection, empty states and unavailable retention/watch-time values.
expected_result: Kinds never mixed into misleading average; null not zero; no impression CTR/API availability claim from old docs; real analytics only after actual account/data evidence.
required_evidence: Compare screenshots and API/seeded totals.

preconditions: Known existing Admin and normal tenant accounts
steps: Open Admin entry; compare admin.whoami with installed app/OTA and failed network cases; test non-Admin denial.
expected_result: Authorized Admin sees entry and diagnostics; non-Admin denied; a hidden entry from failed whoami is diagnosed, not assumed removed by Sprint 5.
required_evidence: whoami boolean/status and screenshots without tokens.

preconditions: Final candidate and completed case results
steps: Check cross-tenant routes/media, Admin audit and receipt/session-secret exclusion; reconcile all 13 open reports and 24 fixed-report smoke coverage, failed/deferred cases and final SHA.
expected_result: No unauthorized media/receipt exposure; bugs closed only on accepted deployed evidence; feedback explicitly covered/partial/deferred; no blanket sprint completion with unresolved blockers.
required_evidence: Final traceability and decision record; no production triage mutation in this planning exercise.
